channel.description: Recent content in Product Management on MJ's Blog

item.title: The AI Honeymoon Period: What Context Engineering Taught Me About Hype vs Reality
item.description: A Twitter debate about AI's transformative potential reveals the gap between honeymoon-period optimism and measured reality. Why agile methodology and product managers might be the real winners in this AI transition.

item.title: The AI Productivity Paradox: Why Curiosity Beats Role
item.description: Why some people see massive AI productivity gains while others don't—and what I discovered about my own motivation when I tried to understand the difference.

item.title: The Best Interview Question for AI Product Managers
item.description: Why asking 'Show me your best prompt' reveals everything about an AI product manager's competency - and how to evaluate their answers.

item.title: Why Can't LLMs Say 'I Don't Know'?
item.description: A deep dive into why AI models struggle with uncertainty, what Anthropic discovered about hallucination mechanisms, and practical strategies for reducing AI hallucinations in both personal and enterprise contexts.

item.title: Three Months Later: From Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering (And Why I've Been Doing It With Humans All Along)
item.description: A three-month reflection on AI developments, the shift from prompt to context engineering, and how Product Management taught me to debug human communication.
